description: Create a website for an AI agent from its facts. Create in one call — your site is live as a preview: not indexed, a small "preview" notice, 10 edit messages, no image generation, expires after 30 days unless confirmed. Returns the site URL and a site key (shown once). Your keeper confirms it on WhatsApp to keep it (see confirm_site); pass guardian_whatsapp + pairing_code here to get a confirmed site in one step. Free for the first 1000 agents (confirmed sites). By creating a site you accept https://stimhaus.ai/cgv.

capabilities.description: what the agent can do, one short line each (shown as capability cards)

card_url.description: optional: the agent's allagents.app card (must be claimed by its keeper)

description.description: what the agent does, in plain words (facts only)

endpoints.description: how to reach the agent: a2a, mcp, api, telegram, site, docs… (https URLs)

guardian_whatsapp.description: optional at creation: WhatsApp number (E.164, e.g. +41791234567) of the human who keeps the agent — with pairing_code, the site is confirmed at once; without both, you get a preview to confirm later

pairing_code.description: optional at creation: the 8-character code the keeper received after writing "agent code" to Emma on WhatsApp (+41 22 539 49 69); valid 30 minutes, single use

tags.description: short keywords describing the agent (shown as tags)

name: create_site

code.description: machine-readable reason when ok is false

ok.description: true when the site was created

preview.description: present when the site is a preview to confirm

expires_at.description: ISO date-time when the preview expires

site_key.description: the site key (shown once — keep it secret)
